introduction: The issuex package provides a forge-neutral Go client interface, canonical domain models, git remote and issue URL detection, a standardized error hierarchy, transport safety utilities, and a no-op implementation for GitHub and GitLab operations.

glossary.Forge: A web-based service hosting Git repositories, issue tracking, and code review workflows, such as GitHub or GitLab.
glossary.ForgeClient: The unified Go interface declaring forge-neutral repository, issue, and pull request operations.
glossary.IssueRef: A reference identifying an issue or pull request within a repository by number.
glossary.NoOpClient: A client implementation that returns zero-values for reads, performs silent no-ops for issue writes, and returns explicit errors for pull request operations.
glossary.Repo: A repository identifier containing owner, name, and optional host segments, supporting nested group paths.

requirements.title: Forge Client Interface Contract
requirements.rationale: A unified interface allows ecosystem tools to interact with multiple git forges using identical method signatures.

criteria.action: declare the Client interface and ForgeClient type alias with Authenticated() bool and Close() error lifecycle methods

declare repository and issue management methods GetRepository, CreateIssue, ReadIssue, UpdateIssue, CloseIssue, ListIssues, AddComment, ListComments, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, and CreateLabel accepting context.Context as first parameter and returning value types

declare pull request management methods CreatePullRequest, ReadPullRequest, ReadChangedFiles, GetPRState, GetCIChecks, GetPRReviews, PostReviewComment, MergePullRequest, and ClosePullRequest accepting context.Context as first parameter and returning value types

requirements.title: Domain Data Models
requirements.rationale: Domain data structures normalize differences between GitHub and GitLab entities into consistent value types.

criteria.action: define the Repo struct with Owner, Name, and Host string fields, where Repo.Valid() reports whether Owner and Name are non-empty
for any Repo instance with non-empty Owner and Name, return fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", r.Owner, r.Name) from Repo.String()
for any IssueRef instance with valid Repo and positive Number, return fmt.Sprintf("%s#%d", ref.Repo.String(), ref.Number) from IssueRef.String()
define the Issue, IssueThread, Comment, and User structs representing issue metadata and comments using value fields and error tracking
define the PullRequest, ChangedFile, PRState, CheckRun, and Review structs representing pull request metadata, changed files, checks, and reviews
define the Repository, RepoPermissions, Label, IssueFilter, IssueList, and CommentList structs with filtering and pagination limits
define CreateIssueRequest, UpdateIssueRequest, CreatePullRequestRequest, MergeOptions, MergeMethod enum constants, and MergeResult structs

requirements.title: Git Remote and URL Parsing
requirements.rationale: Detecting repository references and web URLs simplifies command-line invocations across diverse git configurations.

criteria.condition: ParseRepo is called with a path string containing one or more slash delimiters and non-empty segments
criteria.action: parse the string into a Repo whose Name is the last path segment and Owner is all preceding segments joined by slash, returning the Repo and true

criteria.condition: ParseRepo is called with an empty string or a string without slash delimiters
criteria.action: reject the input and return a zero-value Repo with false

criteria.condition: ParseRemote is called with an HTTPS, SSH, or SCP-style git remote URL matching a supported forge host
criteria.action: parse the remote URL into a Repo containing Host, Owner with multi-segment support, and Name without .git suffix, returning the Repo and true

criteria.condition: ParseRemote is called with an invalid remote URL, missing host, or unsupported format
criteria.action: reject the remote URL and return a zero-value Repo with false

criteria.condition: DetectRepo is called with a directory path whose git origin remote is configured and readable
criteria.action: execute git remote get-url origin in the target directory, pass the output to ParseRemote, and return the resulting Repo with true

criteria.condition: DetectRepo is called on a directory that is not a git repository or has no origin remote configured
criteria.action: return a zero-value Repo with false without returning an error

criteria.condition: ParseIssueURL is called with a valid GitHub or GitLab web issue or pull request URL
criteria.action: parse the URL into an IssueRef with Repo, Number, and IsPullRequest set to true for PR and MR URLs, returning the IssueRef and true

criteria.condition: ParseIssueURL is called with an invalid URL, a non-issue path, or a non-numeric identifier
criteria.action: reject the URL and return a zero-value IssueRef with false

requirements.title: Forge Detection and Options Configuration
requirements.rationale: Automatic forge detection selects the target platform from configuration, environment variables, or local git remotes.

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with Options having NoOp set to true
criteria.action: instantiate and return a NoOpClient instance and nil error

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with BaseURL containing github or api.github.com
criteria.action: resolve the forge type to ForgeTypeGitHub

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with BaseURL containing gitlab
criteria.action: resolve the forge type to ForgeTypeGitLab

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with empty BaseURL and GitHub environment variables are present while GitLab environment variables are absent
criteria.action: resolve the forge type to ForgeTypeGitHub with default endpoint https://api.github.com and credentials from GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with empty BaseURL and GitLab environment variables are present while GitHub environment variables are absent
criteria.action: resolve the forge type to ForgeTypeGitLab with default endpoint https://gitlab.com/api/v4 and credentials from GITLAB_TOKEN

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with empty BaseURL and forge environment variables are either both present or both absent
criteria.guard: the git origin remote in the working directory matches a recognized forge host
criteria.action: resolve the forge type corresponding to the git origin remote host

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions cannot determine the forge type from BaseURL, environment variables, or git origin remote
criteria.action: reject client construction and return a nil Client and an error wrapping ErrAmbiguousForge
criteria.contract: (nil, err) where errors.Is(err, ErrAmbiguousForge) is true

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions resolves a forge type to ForgeTypeGitHub or ForgeTypeGitLab prior to provider adapter registration
criteria.action: reject client construction and return a nil Client and an error wrapping ErrUnsupportedForge indicating the provider adapter is not registered
criteria.contract: (nil, err) where errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupportedForge) is true

requirements.title: Standardized Error Types and Classification
requirements.rationale: Standardized error types allow consumers to distinguish and handle distinct forge failure modes cleanly.

criteria.action: define sentinel errors ErrNoToken, ErrNotFound, ErrConflict, ErrRateLimited, ErrUnsupportedForge, and ErrAmbiguousForge

define HTTPError carrying Method, Path, Status, Message, RetryAfterHeader, RateLimitReset, and RateLimitRemaining, formatted by Error() as fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %d %s", e.Method, e.Path, e.Status, e.Message)

criteria.condition: RetryAfter is called on an HTTPError with status 429 or status 403 with RateLimitRemaining 0 and a valid Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Reset header
criteria.action: calculate the backoff duration from the header value plus a 1-second buffer and return the duration with true

criteria.condition: RetryAfter is called on an HTTPError with non-rate-limit status or missing rate-limit headers
criteria.action: return zero duration and false

criteria.condition: IsNotFound is called with an error
criteria.action: return true if the error wraps ErrNotFound or is an HTTPError with status 404, and false otherwise

criteria.condition: IsConflict is called with an error
criteria.action: return true if the error wraps ErrConflict or is an HTTPError with status 409, and false otherwise

criteria.condition: IsRateLimited is called with an error
criteria.action: return true if the error wraps ErrRateLimited or is an HTTPError with status 429 or status 403 with RateLimitRemaining 0, and false otherwise

criteria.condition: IsNoToken is called with an error
criteria.action: return true if the error wraps ErrNoToken, and false otherwise

requirements.title: Shared Transport Foundation
requirements.rationale: Centralized transport safety prevents out-of-memory errors on large payloads and manages rate-limit backoff consistently.

criteria.action: bound HTTP response body reads using io.LimitReader to a maximum of 8 MB (8388608 bytes)

criteria.condition: an HTTP response status is rate-limited
criteria.guard: the calculated RetryAfter duration is less than or equal to 120 seconds
criteria.action: invoke the injectable sleep function for the duration and retry the request once

criteria.condition: an HTTP response status is rate-limited and the calculated RetryAfter duration exceeds 120 seconds
criteria.action: abort the request and return an error wrapping ErrRateLimited without retrying
criteria.contract: returns an error wrapping ErrRateLimited without issuing a retry request

criteria.condition: an unauthenticated request receives an HTTP 404 status
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound and containing guidance that the target resource may be private and require credentials
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true and containing "resource may be private"

criteria.condition: a custom sleep function is configured on the transport
criteria.action: invoke the custom sleep function instead of time.Sleep during retry backoff

requirements.title: No-Op Client Implementation
requirements.rationale: A no-op client allows tools to operate in offline or forge-disabled environments with predictable issue defaults and failing PR safety.

criteria.condition: Authenticated is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return false

criteria.condition: Close is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return nil

criteria.condition: GetRepository is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return a zero-value Repository and nil

criteria.condition: any issue read method (ReadIssue, ListIssues, ListComments) is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return a zero-value result struct and nil error

criteria.condition: any issue write method (CreateIssue, UpdateIssue, CloseIssue, AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, CreateLabel) is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: perform no remote operation and return zero values with nil error

criteria.condition: any pull request method (CreatePullRequest, ReadPullRequest, ReadChangedFiles, GetPRState, GetCIChecks, GetPRReviews, PostReviewComment, MergePullRequest, ClosePullRequest) is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return an error indicating that pull request operations require an active forge client
criteria.contract: non-nil error containing "pull request operations require an active forge client"

execution_paths.title: No-Op client initialization and silent issue creation

steps.action: instantiates and returns a NoOpClient instance
invokes Authenticated() on the returned client
invokes CreateIssue with target repo and CreateIssueRequest data
completes silently and returns a zero-value Issue struct with nil error

execution_paths.title: Git remote and web issue URL parsing to domain models

steps.action: provides a git remote URL string and a web issue URL string
parses the remote URL into a Repo struct containing host, owner, and name
parses the web issue URL into an IssueRef struct containing Repo, issue number, and pull request flag
invokes String() and URL() on the parsed IssueRef to format identifiers
returns canonical string owner/repo#number and formatted canonical web URL

execution_paths.title: Rate-limit HTTP error inspection and backoff duration calculation

steps.action: receives an HTTP response with status 429 and Retry-After header
parses the response status and headers into an HTTPError struct
invokes IsRateLimited(err) and err.RetryAfter() to inspect the error
reports true for IsRateLimited and returns the backoff duration with a 1-second buffer
